info.title: Multicast_L3_Forwarding
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address_family.description: Represents the address family for this entry.

bridge_replication_portset.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Replication_Portset](#/Multicast_Replication_Portset)
If [type](#/Multicast_L3_Forwarding) is `bridge`, it references to a [Multicast_Replication_Portset](#/Multicast_Replication_Portset). Otherwise, the reference is null.

destination_prefix.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Forwarding)
IPv4 or IPv6 destination prefix. Example 255.0.10.1/32

from.description: Protocol that is responsible for this entry. Possible values are `pim_dm`, `pim_sm`, `pim_bidi` and `static`.

num_retries_requested.description: Number of retries requested for configuring this entry in hardware.

hw_status.description: Status information to indicate the current state of the hardware.

activity.description: Specifies the [Multicast_L3_Forwarding](Multicast_L3_Forwarding) entry activity status during a period of time. This value is updated periodically (every 5 seconds). When set to `active` it indicates the [Multicast_L3_Forwarding](Multicast_L3_Forwarding) entry route is actively participating in multicast traffic. If no activity is seen after the last update, the value will be set to `inactive`.

num_retries_performed.description: Number of times the retries have been performed to the hardware.

replication_group.description:
Reference Resource: [Replication_Group](#/Replication_Group)
Reference to a [Replication_Group](#/Replication_Group) which containts the hardware configuration for the entry.

route_replication_portsets.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Replication_Portset](#/Multicast_Replication_Portset)
If [type](#/Multicast_L3_Forwarding) is `route`, it references to a list of [Multicast_Replication_Portset](#/Multicast_Replication_Portset). Otherwise, the reference is null.

source_prefix.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Forwarding)
IPv4 or IPv6 source prefix. Example 192.168.0.1/32

type.description: Represents the type of multicast L3 Forwarding entry. The types available are `bridge` and `route`

upstream_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Forwarding)
Reference to the Upstream Port (i.e. where multicast traffic is coming from).

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Forwarding)
Reference to a [VRF](#/VRF), to which this multicast L3 bridge control forwading entry belongs. Since [Multicast_L3_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Forwarding) is using IP addresses in [source_prefix](#/Multicast_L3_Forwarding) and [destination_prefix](#/Multicast_L3_Forwarding), a VRF is needed to be able to associate those IP addresses to the VRF when programming the hardware.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
